title: Reddit Story Pipeline
blurb: Automated pipeline that turns Reddit stories into narrated, subtitled vertical videos.
problem: Produces narrated, subtitled videos from Reddit stories without manual editing.
details: Integrates the DeepSeek LLM API for rewriting, TTS voiceover, and subtitle rendering.
Containerized architecture with Docker Compose, persistent session management, and multi-platform publishing to TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.
Reliability from day one: state persistence, post deduplication, dry-run mode for staged rollout, and cron/Ofelia scheduling for up to 3 posts per day.

title: Zenyth IDE
blurb: Native desktop IDE in Tauri and React with local LLM inference over Ollama.
problem: Runs real-time code execution and local AI assistance inside a native desktop app.
details: Streams terminal I/O bidirectionally with zero data loss from a Tauri-wrapped React interface.
Rust proxy for local LLM inference (Ollama) with sub-100ms first-token latency, handling backpressure, cancellation, and graceful error recovery.
React-to-Rust IPC bridge that ports a web-based editor into a fully native desktop application.

title: VencordMobile
blurb: Android client that injects the 155+ plugin Vencord bundle into Discord's mobile web app.
problem: Brings desktop-only Discord plugins to mobile through a native-web bridge.
details: Loads Discord's mobile web app and injects the Vencord plugin bundle (155+ plugins).
Flutter-to-JavaScript bridge via postMessage for bidirectional native-web communication with synchronized state.
Automated delivery: esbuild bundling of 155+ plugins into a single IIFE, with GitHub Actions producing signed APKs on each release tag.
